mostWorthwhile.text: Adding venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned muscle-compression and directional-arrow illustration explains how they support return flow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The capillary-bed picture was rather brief; it did not carry forward the initial detail about the endothelial lining and support sleeves, although the accompanying prose explained exchange.

surprise.text: The venous-return illustration added the role of contracting limb muscle, beyond the expected prevention of backward flow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final vein-building and connection steps were the only offered combinations rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would cautiously continue: the vessel constructions connect structure to function clearly, especially branching and venous valves, though several later steps offered no choice.
